parameters.name: Application Insights resource
parameters.query: where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/components' | project value = id, label = name, selected = true, group = resourceGroup

parameters.name: Log Analytics workspace
parameters.query: where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' | project value = id, label = name, selected = true, group = resourceGroup

parameters.name: Command type
parameters.query: customMetrics | where name == "atlas.command.duration" | extend c = tostring(customDimensions.command) | distinct c | order by c asc

content.title: 1. Overview — application transitions and email outcomes
content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp > {timerange} and name in ("atlas.applications.transitions", "atlas.email.sends")
| extend Metric = case(
    name == "atlas.applications.transitions", strcat("Transition: ", tostring(customDimensions.transition)),
    strcat("Email: ", tostring(customDimensions.outcome)))
| summarize Total = sum(Value) by Metric
| order by Total desc

content.title: 2. Application errors — exceptions over time
content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp > {timerange}
| summarize ExceptionCount = count() by problemId, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: 3. Command performance — duration percentiles by command type
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "atlas.command.duration" and timestamp > {timerange}
| extend Command = tostring(customDimensions.command)
| where isempty('{commandtype}') or Command == '{commandtype}'
| summarize p50=percentile(Value, 50), p95=percentile(Value, 95), p99=percentile(Value, 99), Samples=count() by Command
| order by p95 desc

content.title: 4. Dependency failures — SQL / Blob / HTTP
content.query:
dependencies
| where success == false and timestamp > {timerange}
| summarize Failures = count() by dependencyType, name
| order by Failures desc

content.title: 5. Email delivery — sends by outcome (custom metric)
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "atlas.email.sends" and timestamp > {timerange}
| extend Outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| summarize Total = sum(Value) by Outcome
| project Outcome, Total

content.title: 6. Email delivery duration percentiles
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "atlas.email.duration" and timestamp > {timerange}
| extend Outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| summarize p50=percentile(Value, 50), p95=percentile(Value, 95), Samples=count() by Outcome

content.title: 7. Azure resource diagnostics — platform logs from Log Analytics
content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > {timerange}
| summarize Events = count() by Category, ResourceProvider
| order by Events desc
